note: Official browser review confirmed that the API add-on is available on all plans. Owner, Admin, and Member roles can use it. The add-on must be installed and permissions allowed before a user generates an API key. The documented actions include messages, reactions, channels, and channel reads.

Official browser review confirmed that stores on paid plans access the API. Ecwid documents a free paid-plan upgrade for a qualifying test store, including public-app development and safe integration work. Custom apps provide store-scoped access tokens.

Official browser review confirmed OAuth 2.0 and the rw_ads marketing scope. Advertising API access requires LinkedIn approval. Development tier supports unlimited read-only ad accounts and edits on up to five ad accounts. Standard tier requires a separate application for unlimited campaign-management edits. The relevant source also requires member account roles for ad-account actions.

Official browser review confirmed bearer tokens, personal and workspace access tokens, and OAuth 2.0. Workspace access requires a workspace admin, depends on plan availability, and OAuth workspace scope requires a Grain-verified client. Personal credentials and MCP authentication use personal scope.
